label: Reviewed carrier and relation sense tags for the Fourth Way identification obligations, measured
summary:
Follow-up to the #1832 pilot (PR #1843, attempts e63628f1 and e8bf6def, not merged at 87a1ca5f9; this attempt records the outcome there). Reviewed whole-binder sense tags for the carriers and relations that the pilot's identification obligations named, then measured the effect on the six Fourth Way targets 64498e7e, 4c79298d, 6c27657f, a9622441, eaa4c679, 101bdd62. DECISIONS. Each pair was decided by reading both declarations, their doc comments or module docstrings, the statement definition links and the sense definitions; the identifications made by instantiation in the verified arguments 8542e377, 4d1efe91 and c201b61a were used as evidence, not copied. (1) Being carriers, BEING_1 (being as entity, DISAMB-BEING): Entity of Aristotle's AsToBeingSoToTruthReading and CauseOfQualityInAnotherIsMoreSuchReading ('each thing'), Being of the quarta via, q.4 a.2, In Metaph. II (its module says its beings and respects are those of the quarta via readings), Stage-one and Stage-two declarations, B of GodMaximalCausal (3), PreexistenceWithoutTransfer (2), CausalMapsBatch1.CauseOfBeingHasWhatItGives and the shared CausalityFrame and GradesFrame. Each module reads its carrier as the beings of the one prima/quarta via vocabulary; none restricts it to bodies or to one series. (2) Respect carriers: no Respect sense existed. DEF-RESPECT (linked by about 160 records) could not itself become a sense without forcing a sense tag into each of their labels (truth check reported 157 label errors when tried), so a separate carrier-sense record RESPECT_1 (2b71ac5e, content DEF-RESPECT, after the frame-field pattern of 5cbd5a0a and eafd5d52) was created in a new disambiguation RESPECT (e795b5ae), with the contrasting RESPECT_2 (8c2658aa): a constructed finite model's respect type, after the schema-model sense of CASE_SIGNATURE_INTERPRETATION (#1823). Tagged RESPECT_1: the same declarations as (1) except SomethingOtherThanGodExists, which has no respect carrier. The tag fixes only the domain; it chooses no distinguished respect and decides nothing about which respects are perfections. (3) Relations. IN_ACT_4: Aristotle's Has (possession of a respect, mode open; DEF-ESSE reads InAct x esse as having being), InAct of ExceededPerfectionIsCausedReading, DistinctCauseHasWhatItGives and CauseOfBeingHasWhatItGives. MORE_1: MoreIn of ExceededPerfectionIsCausedReading, MoreInIsAsymmetric, CauseOfBeingIsMoreInBeing and both Aristotle readings (the primitive comparative, no order laws). CAUSE_2: CausesIn of ExceededPerfectionIsCausedReading, NoInfiniteRegressOfCausesOfAPerfectionReading, DistinctCauseHasWhatItGives, CauseOfBeingIsMoreInBeing, GodCausesBeingOfAllOthers, SimplyPriorIsCauseOfBeing and Aristotle's CauseOfQualityInAnotherIsMoreSuchReading (whose doc comment says CausesIn carries no synonymy condition, as DEF-CAUSE-OF-PERFECTION). Esse respect (WORLD_RELATIVE_EXISTENCE_METAPHYSICAL_ESSE_NECESSITY_5): esse of GodCausesBeingOfAllOthers, CauseOfBeingIsMoreInBeing, SimplyPriorIsCauseOfBeing, CauseOfBeingHasWhatItGives, and Aristotle's being, read as the respect in which a thing has being; the Thomistic thesis that esse is the actuality of all acts is not attributed to Metaphysics II.1 (it is the open premise ActualityOnlyInsofarAsBeingReading, outside the field). PRIOR_1: PriorSimply of SimplyPriorIsCauseOfBeing. GOD_4: IsGod of StageTwo.GodIsMaximalInBeing, GodCausesBeingOfAllOthers and SomethingOtherThanGodExists, whose statements link DEF-GOD-OF-CLASSICAL-THEISM. TRUE_7 (new thin sense 9d37eba3, truth said of things: the respect of being true said of a thing rather than a sentence): verum of MostTrueIsMostBeingReading and GradesFoundInThingsReading and Aristotle's truth, whose doc comment reads truth as said of things; Aquinas cites the sentence for the step and 8542e377 instantiates truth by verum. Review on PR #1848 (P1) rejected the first version, which put these three tags on TRUE_3 (DEF-ONTOLOGICAL-TRUTH): that sense is Aquinas's analysis of the truth of things as conformity to an intellect (ST I q.16 a.1), which Metaphysics II.1 does not state (E.4, 1027b25-27 puts truth in thought). The tags were moved to TRUE_7, after the pattern of the esse respect record eafd5d52; TRUE_3 is recorded as one open way of filling TRUE_7 in. Statement 5a948c37's existing link to DEF-ONTOLOGICAL-TRUTH and its claim are left for a separate follow-up. REFUSED OR LEFT UNTAGGED, with reasons. (a) DEF-RESPECT as the sense itself: refused for the label reason above; a merge needs every linked record relabelled. (b) DEF-PHYSICAL-RESPECT or respects of change as a second RESPECT sense: refused; they are guarded subclasses of one carrier, and two arguments (ARIST-PHYS-VIII-4) link both DEF-RESPECT and DEF-PHYSICAL-RESPECT, so a sense split would misreport them as mixing. (c) Partial-application slices (CausesIn _ _ esse, CAUSING_AN_EFFECT_3) on the new declarations: not added; they identify nothing and were not on any obligation. (d) The frame-bound declarations (CartesianAdequacy.ContainmentInEveryCause and the GradesFrame adapters): their carriers are section variables of a frame binder F, not signature binders; left untagged, so the Cartesian route 400ba1f0 still uses a frame bundle. (e) Rest of the IN_ACT_4/MORE_1 cluster (about 25 further declarations) and other IsGod binders: not reviewed here, left unknown. (f) TRUE_3 on any of these binders: refused after review, see TRUE_7 above. LEAN. GodMaximalCausal and PreexistenceWithoutTransfer declared B and R as section variables, which the offline tag reader does not count as signature binders; the five declarations now state {B R : Type} (or {B : Type}) in their own signatures. The elaborated constants are unchanged (binder export before the edit: B, R in the same order, R absent from SomethingOtherThanGodExists); lake build and bind-check of the 321 affected results pass. MEASURED at base 87a1ca5f9 (reports are local, under the worker's scratch directory outside the repository, and are cited by run name only), Duper only, default 8 candidates, 100k heartbeats. Plain run, explicit targets, pool all (scripts/run-discovery.sh): before (report 20261122T162154Z-an7P3DcB) 6 unresolved, 0 proved; after (report 20261122T163553Z-UkBtUGdy) 6 unresolved, 0 proved, identical candidate lists for every goal; the tagged carriers now enter the goals with BEING_1/RESPECT_1 and by-name carrier identifications drop from 69 to 50 over the six goals. The plain run is unchanged because retrieval does not use the tags. Identification-only runs, on five targets; a9622441 was left out because its only verified route (bfaf6f92, the cogito route over CogitoSubject and MotionMapsBatch1 vocabulary) takes its premises from declarations none of which this attempt tags, so a restricted run would not test these tags (the same command with --module restricted to the target and its known-route premise declarations plus ExcludedMiddle, so retrieval cannot hide the known premises; with the corpus tags stashed for before): before 5 of 5 unresolved; after 3 proved (101bdd62 rerun after the TRUE_7 move, report 20261122T175434Z-Jx6Dh9V9: the same proof and filters, verum and truth now joined by TRUE_7): 101bdd62 from 5a948c37, filtered known (8542e377) and senses (MAXIMAL_IN_A_SELECTED_PERFECTION_GREATEST_1 against _6, the existing definition-link inconsistency noted in attempt 9869069b); 64498e7e from f8ba2429, c11369aa and d5a94eb1, reported as a certified discovery (propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound), which is the verified argument 6b609ddc without its explicit excluded-middle premise ee4ab504, so known modulo the classical logic that Duper supplies; eaa4c679 from 70e98bb5 and 18561596, reported as a discovery, which is the pilot's route c9bdd003 (PR #1843, not merged) again without the excluded-middle premise. Neither discovery is registered; both are conditional on OPEN premises and are known routes, not new philosophy. 4c79298d and 6c27657f stay unresolved even narrowed: retrieval eligibility admitted only 86d02b69, e4484bdc, cffad050 and only c11369aa, f29a6b53 respectively. RETRIEVAL MISSES (input for engine work). (i) Ranking uses parameter names, not tags: in the full pool 5a948c37 (101bdd62), 70e98bb5 (eaa4c679), d5a94eb1/c11369aa/d0fc96b7/634a80b8 (64498e7e), all five known premises of 4c79298d and all four of 6c27657f are outside the top 8, both before and after tagging. (ii) Eligibility (shared parameter name plus shared project vocabulary or definition) excludes, even from a narrowed pool, MoreInIsAsymmetric a4814f25 and MoreSuchHasThePerfectionReading c11369aa for 4c79298d, DistinctCauseHasWhatItGives 2c0b9bd7 and NoInfiniteRegressOfCausesOfAPerfectionReading 5cda1946 for 6c27657f: they mention no project constant and share no definition_ids with the target. A shared whole-binder sense would be the natural eligibility signal. (iii) ExcludedMiddle ee4ab504 is never a candidate, and the known filter does not match a proof that uses the classical axioms in place of an argument's explicit ee4ab504 premise, so known routes resurface as discoveries. No proof, closure or frontier change (frontier-diff against origin/main: no change). FOLLOW-UP 2026-11-24, baseline ad4ffa2e5fbd245434f3d4b468f42f2b3f9ffaf2. Added only the missing Being/BEING_1 and Respect/RESPECT_1 carrier tags of TruthCore.Causality.TermSenseForks.SomeBeingMaximalInBeing (fad8af3e). Its TermSenseForks3 module explicitly reads this declaration as the quarta via maximal-being existence use and defines it as an existential of the existing IsMaximalIn InAct MoreIn esse predicate; its IN_ACT_4, MORE_1 and esse-respect tags already existed. The domains therefore match those of GodIsMaximalInBeing, MaximumHasNoDistinctEsseCause and GodCausesBeingOfAllOthers without identifying any new relation, adding an order law, conflating maximal/greatest/strict senses or asserting that these open premises hold. The exact benchmark bundle for 4c79298d is 18561596 (a maximal being has no distinct cause of its being), fad8af3e (some being is maximal) and 86d02b69 (God causes the being of every other being). Any God must be that maximal witness: otherwise its cause-of-being edge contradicts the first premise. The adaptive-repair attempt already recorded this conditional relationship after #1850, filtered by name-only carriers; removing that identification filter would make a previously discovered relationship admissible, not establish a novel philosophical claim. An offline graph-closure inspection at the baseline did not find a registered composition from this bundle even with excluded middle, which is distinct from whether research has already reported the relationship. The carrier-tag curation changes no statement, declaration body, Challenge, premise, source claim, canonical ID, argument or result; the later support-registration proposal is recorded separately below. Independent semantic review on 2026-11-24 accepted the two carrier tags in curation commit 0777c61e6 after inspecting the exact definitions, existing sense tuple, downstream consumers and all benchmark fixture references; no substantiated findings were reported. That review accepts the scope of these identifications, not the truth or warrant of the open premises, and changes no proof. The fresh measurements below complete that before/after test; review of the full measured outcome and the follow-on support registration remains separate and pending.

MEASURED FOLLOW-UP 2026-11-24. The six-case fixture scripts/testdata/discovery-benchmark.json was frozen before execution (SHA-256 ffbdb95ca2166b85440c6dfc382f79aa6ebfb0679ccfe91ca9c95b69c45fda56, unchanged). The scored budget is --heartbeats 10000 (the CLI unit is thousands), batch 1, jobs 1; ranked selection uses pool all and cap 8. Baseline ranked runs use ad4ffa2e5; exact-before-tags uses engine revision 76f23a354; tagged runs use 4b04b0352. Both exact revisions use the same executable hash 70f805eaf3326c9e6241a911d71dad0a0b87ae8a17643a210ab2f106f9048624, so their comparison changes the corpus carrier tags, not proof search or its budget. Run names below identify report.json under the local discovery-evidence directory; summary.seconds is engine duration, not whole-command elapsed time. A pre-runtime-relocation unavailable run is excluded from all scored outcomes.

For 4c79298d, ranked-before (20261124T094400Z-6uMKptFv) is unresolved in 106 s with 8 name-only carrier identifications; exact-before (20261124T095218Z-80JWFVeB) is unresolved in 33 s with 2. Ranked-after (20261124T095912Z-vgi5XUoq) is unresolved in 109 s with 6; exact-after (20261124T100210Z-PLQnCdwa) is unresolved in 36 s with none. All four runs have zero errors. All three reference premises were already in the ranked top 8 before curation (18561596 first, fad8af3e second, 86d02b69 seventh); after curation only the first two exchange order, with the candidate set unchanged. This is no retrieval-recall gain and no proof-closure gain at the frozen budget. The exact path exposes the reviewed three-premise bundle through the normal identification, minimization and rejection checks; supplying it is an intervention, not an automatic-retrieval success. The six remaining ranked name-only obligations belong to other candidates, not the curated declaration.

A separately labelled supplemental comparison raises only the exact-run budget to --heartbeats 100000 and is not part of the frozen score. Before tags (20261124T095440Z-oagkWI4u), Duper proves the target from all three premises in 49 s, rejected only by domain_by_name for the two untagged carriers. After tags (20261124T095740Z-JpyYcxH6), it proves the same three-premise bundle in 48 s, retains all three premises, reports no name-only identifications or filters, and certifies the emitted proof with propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound. Thus the measured improvement is admissibility of a previously reported conditional proof, not a proof-rate increase or a novel relationship. The prior report in #1850, #1860 and attempt 3bd2aeb2 excludes it from novelty credit: zero novel findings. Removing the filter does not establish any premise.

SUPPORT REGISTRATION, added separately in e182d1108cf4d7736b59ab42703c9aabd8d63f65: argument 14cbab05, result d377c7c7, theorem TruthCore.Results.Discover.GodMaximalFromCauseExclusion.godMaximalFromCauseExclusion. A read-only graph inspection at main 6ecc2d87c3576906cb32ea8dbbca22e7557cce6b found no registered composition from the three premises, with or without excluded middle; the missing graph edge is distinct from historical novelty. Relative to 4d1efe91, the proposed route retains God-causes-all-others but uses maximal existence and distinct-cause exclusion instead of cause-more, bearer possession, asymmetry and an other-being witness. It is a different conditional support option, not a certified globally weaker bundle. It asserts no God existence and no independent corroboration: exclusion 18561596 already has support through 8bbe817d from d5a94eb1, so choosing that route retains the dependency. The registration supplies this alternative bundle to existing simplicity, immutability and classical-attribute consumers of the same target; their other premises remain open and their frozen Challenges are unchanged. At coordinator revision 5ddbb714ed928b37823c83e241a3351f16f15dc7, the TruthCore build, focused result bind-check (1 bound, 0 mismatch), Comparator and result NanoDa checks pass; the raw evidence is under discovery-evidence/registered-support. Countermodel --all --size 2 also gives a Lean-checked omission model for each of the three hypotheses: h0/distinct-cause exclusion on 2 beings and 1 respect, h1/maximal existence on 1 being and 1 respect, and h2/God-causes-others on 2 beings and 1 respect. Thus no hypothesis can simply be deleted from this fixed encoded bundle; this is inclusion-minimality, not a globally weakest or philosophically necessary assumption set. The joint witness uses 1 being and 1 respect with IsGod false, so it witnesses formal joint satisfiability only, not a God-existence or nonvacuity witness and not metaphysical coherence. Full-outcome independent semantic review remains pending here; the earlier tag-only acceptance does not certify it. The integrated frontier-diff against origin/main at 6ecc2d87c3576906cb32ea8dbbca22e7557cce6b computes 602 to 603 distinct verified support alternatives, with one added for 4c79298d; reaching-root open premises remain 581 (430 bare, 92 supported, 59 stated), the lowest expanded-route cost remains 16, and no bare premise is added. This is conditional support-option progress without premise establishment. The recorded engine durations are single-run diagnostics; agent token and effort costs were not measured.
blocker: Current disposition (2026-11-24): exact --premise execution and the Being/Respect tag rerun are complete, with the four frozen-budget outcomes and the separate supplemental admissibility gain recorded above. The registered support bundle has passed its build, focused binding, Comparator and NanoDa gates at coordinator revision 5ddbb714e, with three checked omission models; complete independent review of the full outcome and record the computed integrated frontier delta; do not substitute the supplemental 100000-budget success for the frozen 10000-budget result or count the historically reported relationship as novel. The frozen maximality goal remains a solver/budget limitation after its exact bundle is supplied and identified. Other curation remains separate: review the remaining untagged cluster carriers and IsGod binders, including the six name-only identifications on other ranked candidates; reconcile the MAXIMAL_IN_A_SELECTED_PERFECTION_GREATEST_1/_6 definition links of MostTrueIsMostBeingReading and 5a948c37; and assess the latter statement's DEF-ONTOLOGICAL-TRUTH link against the thin TRUE_7 sense. Retrieval by tags and classical-background matching were delivered by #1850 and are not current gaps. No stronger source reading or premise warrant follows from this metadata change.
